query:
INSERT INTO entries (
                    global_id, 
                    payee, 
                    start_time, 
                    end_time, 
                    memo, 
                    category_id
                )
                VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, ?5, ?6)
                RETURNING 
                    id,
                    global_id as "global_id: Uuid",
                    payee,
                    start_time,
                    end_time,
                    duration_ms as "duration_ms: Option<i64>",
                    memo,
                    category_id as "category_id: i64",
                    created_at, 
                    updated_at, 
                    deleted_at, 
                    version as "version: i64"
